description:
The front rotor and detangler allow for smooth, tangle-free handlebar spins, giving riders the freedom to pull off epic tricks with ease. Whether at the park or on the streets, this BMX is built for bold moves.
The durable steel frame is built to handle jumps, grinds, and high-impact riding, giving you the confidence to push your limits. Backed by a limited lifetime warranty, this BMX is made for endless freestyle fun.
Front and rear pegs give you the freedom to master grinds, stalls, and freestyle moves. Whether you're hitting the skatepark or the streets, these pegs add style and versatility to every ride.
Front and rear caliper brakes deliver smooth, responsive stopping power, so you can ride with confidence. The textured grips ensure a secure hold, giving you full control over every trick and turn.
The durable chain guard keeps the chain covered, protecting your bike from dirt and debris while keeping your ride looking fresh. Designed for both safety and style, it’s built for BMX action.

components.description: Precision Braking Control: Front and rear caliper brakes ensure smooth, responsive stopping power when you need it.
